notes: Higher-SNR K8B raw I/Q capture (2026-05-27) intended as a stock-eti-stuff-compatible OFDM oracle for dab-rs Stage 4-7 validation. Replaces k8b_rust.iq (SNR ~7 dB, stock eti-stuff failed to lock). PSD contrast +25.5 dB peak vs outer-5% noise floor (vs +21.6 dB in k8b_rust), confirming substantially stronger antenna chain at the same Sinnonhyeon location. However, the null/µ ratio is structurally shallow (median 0.78 across 83 frames, range 0.72-0.82) due to 5-transmitter SFN multipath fill — a documented gotcha (#4) that is a LOCATION characteristic, not an SNR characteristic. Empirically stock eti-cmdline-rawfiles still locks despite this (its time-sync algorithm is more permissive than the static 0.50·sLevel comparison suggests — sLevel itself adapts), producing 502 ETI frames and identifying the full ensemble (EId 0xE040 YTN DMB + all 5 SubCh + 4-5 services). However, FIB CRC pass rate is low (10.9%) and the outer T-DMB RS chain decodes 0/2587 blocks: the 8-bit cu8 quantization (required for the eti-cmdline-rawfiles input format) loses 4-5 dB of effective SNR relative to native int16 processing, dropping us below the RS correction threshold. Net effect: usable as an OFDM/inner-FEC oracle (Stages 1-7 of dab-rs), NOT usable for end-to-end video decode (would need the 12-bit native pipeline of eti-cmdline-airspy with the original Brisa+LNA setup that produced k8b_100pct.eti at SNR ~13 dB).

environment.antenna: upgraded antenna chain (improved over 41 cm 1/4-lambda monopole used in k8b_rust)
environment.location: Sinnonhyeon (신논현), Seocho-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea — indoor near window
environment.sfn_multipath_note: 5 metro K8B SFN transmitters (Namsan ~5 km, Gwanaksan ~15 km, Yongmunsan ~44 km, Gwanggyosan ~24 km, Unjung ~10 km) all in line-of-sight or near-LOS; their delayed copies fill the OFDM null interval regardless of received signal strength. Null/µ stays at 0.72-0.82 with omnidirectional antenna. A directional Yagi pointing at Namsan would suppress 4 of the 5 to restore textbook null depth.

A_snr_geq_13_db.verdict: PARTIAL — PSD-based metric exceeds threshold, eti-stuff's internal OFDM SNR estimator says 5 dB (after cu8 quantization losses)

B_null_mu_leq_040.verdict: FAIL — but empirically not blocking (eti-stuff still locked; see acceptance C). Confirms gotcha #4 is a structural location feature, not an SNR feature.

C_stock_eti_full_decode.criterion: stock eti-cmdline-rawfiles produces ETI + ensemble JSON with YTN DMB EId 0xE040 and 5 services
C_stock_eti_full_decode.conversion: scipy.signal.resample_poly(iq, 256, 375) → cu8 with 99.9%ile scaled to 0.85 of full range
C_stock_eti_full_decode.verdict: PASS — stock eti-stuff (no patches) decodes ensemble and full service list from this capture. Confirms the capture is a valid oracle for dab-rs Stages A (FEC/MSC/FIC) and the OFDM/inner-FEC pipeline (Stages 1-7).

downstream_rs_decode.verdict: FAIL — 0/2587 RS blocks correctable. BER exceeds t=8 RS correction limit on every block. Cause: cu8 quantization + SFN multipath + ~5 dB effective OFDM SNR. NOT a video-decode-quality capture.

validation.verdict_summary: GOOD AS OFDM/INNER-FEC ORACLE FOR dab-rs (Stages 1-7). NOT USABLE FOR VIDEO DECODE (use k8b_100pct.eti for that).

intended_use_for_dab_rs: Week 3c (Stage 4 NCO + integer carrier offset detection)
Week 3c (Stage 5 FFT framing per OFDM symbol)
Week 3e (Stage 7 π/4-DQPSK demap to soft bits, with +/-1 polarity convention from gotcha #1)
Stage B byte-identical cross-check (compare dab-rs Viterbi output to eti-stuff intermediate dump)
Stage C byte-identical cross-check (compare dab-rs per-symbol FFT spectrum to eti-stuff dump)
ETI-level cross-check (dab-rs end-to-end ETI output should match strong.eti from this capture)
not_for: End-to-end MP4 video decode demonstration — RS BER exceeds correction limit
FIB ≥ 50% reference — current FIB pass rate is only 10.9%
